summary: Listed as a Richmond County, NC tower; a 100-foot steel tower erected by the U.S. Resettlement Administration in 1936-38. No source read gives its current status.

notes_for_editor: Only one compilation (the Forest Lookouts North Carolina listing) gives the build and lease details. It cites the 7th Biennial Report (1938) of the Department of Conservation and Development, which was not read directly; the story relies on the listing's summary. The tnlandforms index gives coordinates and county only. The Wikipedia article is used only for the town's location. The NHLR register has no Hamlet entry: the full North Carolina list (31 names) was read on the page and none is Hamlet. The brief's status and access stay unknown: no source read says whether the tower stands or is public. The listing's 1964-66 relocation line belongs to the Greenville entry and is not used here. Body text is about 135 words, within the guide's range.
